# Phone Remote EMP
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

![Phone Remote EMP](images/items/20295_emp_phone.png)

*Combine it with a Mobile Phone from your inventory to sync the two, press \[F\] to plant it, then press \[F\] with the phone in hand to detonate.*

| Property | Value |
|:--|:--|
| Size | 2 |
| Category | Explosive |
| Hit points | 1 |
| Charge | EMP |
| Trigger | Radio |
| Blast radius | 12 m |
